name: decisions-5-5
text: Rule decisions confirmed by the founder on 2026-09-13. These count toward the O-1A and supersede the June research.
YC or accelerator acceptance counts under #1 awards and #2 membership (D-accelerator-acceptance).
Founder equity in place of salary counts under #8 as comparable evidence (D-equity-comparable).
Venture funding counts under #8; it never counts as an award (D-funding-remuneration, T-funding-not-award).
Conference talks count under #6 as comparable evidence (D-talk-comparable).
Code reviews on popular open-source repos count under #4 as comparable evidence (D-code-review-comparable).
Stars and forks from others count under #3 as comparable evidence, alongside #5 (C5-adoption).
IADAS and merit-based open-source organization membership count under #2 (C2-selective-membership).
